name: Ha Long Bay
blurb: Conversation about Ha Long Bay is up 196% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Easy to get around without a car
Good value compared with last year
Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
negative: Prices noticeably up on last season

quotes.text: Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Second time here and it still feels underrated.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
